readme:
# Meshy UV Unwrap
Meshy UV Unwrap creates a clean UV layout for an existing 3D model before texturing.
## Fields
| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model_url` | string, required | — | URL of the 3D model (GLB, GLTF, FBX, OBJ or STL) as a public URL or data URI. |
## Output
- `url`: GLB with new UVs.
- `thumbnail`: Preview image.
## Billing
$0.20 per model. The mesh can have at most 40,000 faces.
